spec.description: PBS dashboard with influxdb2 and proxmox Metric Server

spec.title: Memory in Use
spec.description: Memory in use by Host OS, VM's and Containers

spec.query:
memUsed = from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "memory" and
    r._field == "memused"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

memTotal = from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "memory" and
    r._field == "memtotal"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

join(
  tables: {used: memUsed, total: memTotal},
  on: ["_time", "host"]
)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: (float(v: r._value_used) / float(v: r._value_total)) * 100.0,
      host: r.host,
      _field: "memused_percent",
      _measurement: "memory",
    }))
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "cpustat" and
    r._field == "iowait_percent"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn:mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "cpustat" and
    r._field == "cpu"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockstat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "avail" or r._field == "used")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${server}" and not exists r["datastore"])
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with 
    _time: r._time,
    _measurement: r.measurement,
    _field: "used_perc",
    _value: float(v: 100) / (float(v: r.avail) + float(v: r.used)) * float(v:r.used)
     }))
  |> drop(columns: ["avail","used"])

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "blockstat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "read_bytes")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] > 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] =~ /${server:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["host","host"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s)
//  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "blockstat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "write_bytes")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] > 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] =~ /${server:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["host","host"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s)
//  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "nics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "receive")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["instance"] == "bond0" or r["instance"] == "enp2s0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] > 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] =~ /${server:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["host","host"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
//  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "nics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "send")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["instance"] == "bond0" or r["instance"] == "enp2s0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] > 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] =~ /${server:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["host","host"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
//  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "cpustat" and
    r._field == "cpu_count"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> limit(n:1)

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "blockstat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "avail" or r["_field"] == "total" or r["_field"] == "used")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] =~ /${server:regex}/ and exists r["datastore"])


  |> group(columns: ["host",  "_field", "datastore"], mode: "by") // Group by host, nodename, vmid, and field

  |> last()
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with 
    _time: r._time,
    _measurement: r.measurement,
    disk_perc: float(v:r.avail) / float(v:r.total) * float(v: 100)
     }))
    




  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "_field"])
